# Tendkit

> Customer support you own: a shared inbox, tickets and a customer portal that you copy into your own app with the shadcn CLI. Customer emails, WhatsApp and SMS become tickets your team answers next to the customer's account. MIT licensed.

Tendkit targets Next.js (App Router), Tailwind 4, shadcn/ui, TanStack Query and Drizzle (Postgres, or SQLite/Cloudflare D1). Channel adapters use only fetch and WebCrypto, so they run on Cloudflare Workers, Node, Bun and Deno.

## Install

`npx shadcn@latest add https://tendkit.softwaresavants.dev/r/support.json https://tendkit.softwaresavants.dev/r/support-postgres.json https://tendkit.softwaresavants.dev/r/support-ui.json https://tendkit.softwaresavants.dev/r/channel-resend.json`

Registry items: support (core), support-postgres, support-d1, support-ui, channel-resend, channel-microsoft365, channel-gmail, channel-smtp, channel-twilio, channel-whatsapp, channel-telegram, channel-api. Each is at https://tendkit.softwaresavants.dev/r/<item>.json.

## How to integrate (for coding agents)

1. Install the items above with the shadcn CLI (server items into the API package, support-ui into the web app in a monorepo).
2. Export the support schema from the Drizzle schema and generate a migration. Don't apply migrations without asking.
3. Create the service with createSupport({ store, storage, channels, directory, notify, acknowledgement, fromName, portalChannelId, ignoreFrom }).
4. Implement the SupportDirectory: identify (sender to user and customer/account), searchCustomers, getCustomers, listAgents. This is the only product-specific part.
5. Route POST /api/webhooks/support/[channel] to support().handleWebhook(channel, request). Call support().runScheduled() from a cron every few minutes.
6. Expose the agent methods (listTickets, getTicket, reply, addNote, assign, setStatus, linkCustomer, uploadAttachment, attachmentUrl, counts, listAgents, searchCustomers) and support().portal through the app's own API behind its own auth; implement SupportClient with them and render SupportInbox/SupportTicket inside SupportProvider.
7. For email: use a receiving subdomain (e.g. in.acme.com) for the reply address, keep the main mailbox where it is, and copy mail to the receiving address. The Resend adapter needs a Full access API key to read received mail.
